title: Beyond Best-of-$k$: Prior-Consistent DAPS for Ambiguous Nonlinear Inverse Problems
abstract: arXiv:2610.31592v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion models have become strong priors for solving inverse problems. However, nonlinear inverse problems such as phase retrieval remain challenging when multiple measurement-consistent solutions are distinguishable only by the prior; we call such measurements ambiguous. Existing diffusion-based samplers rely on local approximations during reconstruction. For an ambiguous measurement, these approximations can allow measurement guidance to favor a measurement-consistent mode that is close to a prior-supported mode but is itself not supported by the prior. Evaluation often masks this type of failure by reporting the best-of-$k$ runs, where the best is selected by comparison to the ground truth. We introduce Prior-Consistent DAPS (PC-DAPS), a variant of Decoupled Annealing Posterior Sampling (DAPS) designed to address this failure case by maintaining multiple candidate solutions within a single sampling run. translated_title: 超越Best-of-$k$：面向歧义非线性逆问题的先验一致DAPS
translated_abstract: 扩散模型已成为求解逆问题的强大先验。然而，当多个测量一致的解只能依靠先验才能区分时，诸如相位恢复等非线性逆问题仍然具有挑战性；我们将这类测量称为“歧义”测量。现有的基于扩散的采样器在重建过程中依赖局部近似。对于歧义测量，这些近似可能使测量引导偏向某个与先验支持的模式接近、但本身并不被先验支持的测量一致模式。评估中常用的best-of-$k$（多次运行取最优）报告方式会掩盖这种失败，因为“最优”结果是通过与真值比较来选择的。我们提出了先验一致DAPS（PC-DAPS），这是解耦退火后验采样（DAPS）的一种变体，旨在通过在单次采样运行中维持多个候选解来解决这一失败情形。随着退火噪声的降低……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 针对歧义非线性逆问题中测量引导可能收敛到先验不支持的解这一失败情形，本文提出PC-DAPS，通过在单次采样运行中维持多个候选解来保持先验一致性，从而超越了依赖真值比较的best-of-$k$评估方式。
en_tdlr: PC-DAPS extends Decoupled Annealing Posterior Sampling to maintain multiple candidate solutions within a single run, addressing prior-inconsistent failure modes in ambiguous nonlinear inverse problems that are masked by best-of-$k$ evaluation.
